title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for management of type 2 diabetes.

HPI
The patient is a 58-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up regarding his type 2 diabetes mellitus. He reports that his blood glucose levels have been poorly controlled over the last month despite consistent adherence to his current regimen. He reports increased thirst and frequent urination. He is currently managed with long-term insulin therapy and does not take any oral medications.

Medication List
- Insulin (long-term)

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Physical exam shows no acute distress. Skin is intact. Vital signs are stable within normal limits.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
2. Hyperglycemia.

Plan
The patient will continue his current insulin regimen. We will monitor his blood glucose levels more frequently over the next month. The patient was instructed to keep a log of his daily readings and report any significant fluctuations. Follow-up appointment scheduled in four weeks.
explanations: Diabetes documented as poorly controlled, out of control, or with hyperglycemia is coded to diabetes with hyperglycemia.
Long-term insulin use in type 2 diabetes: add Z79.4.

distractors.why: Hyperglycemia is a complication with its own code.
Z79.4 is required for routine insulin use in type 2 diabetes.
